name: CriticBench
description: CriticBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to assess Large Language Models' abilities to critique and rectify their reasoning across five domains: mathematical, commonsense, symbolic, coding, and algorithmic. It compiles 15 datasets and evaluates generation, critique, and correction reasoning capabilities of LLMs.
reputation: A recent but well-regarded benchmark in the reasoning community for measuring critique and self-correction abilities across multiple domains.
notes: Includes 15 datasets spanning five reasoning domains and evaluates 17 LLMs; highlights critique-correct reasoning capabilities and inter-model critiquing dynamics.
